tutorial.step1.title: Open the app
tutorial.step1.description: You are in the right place. Noland Connect will walk you from account setup to launching your first cloud computer.
tutorial.step2.title: Open Vast.ai
tutorial.step2.description: Head to Vast.ai next. That is where you rent the GPU machine that Noland Connect will prepare for you.
tutorial.step3.title: Create your Vast.ai account
tutorial.step3.description: Make your Vast.ai account if you are new. It only takes a minute and unlocks server access.
tutorial.step4.title: Add billing
tutorial.step4.description: Add payment in Vast.ai billing so you can rent a server when you are ready to launch.
tutorial.step5.title: Get your API key
tutorial.step5.description: Copy your Vast.ai API key. Noland Connect uses it to find servers, start them, and manage the setup for you.
tutorial.step6.title: Return to Noland
tutorial.step6.description: After billing and API key setup, return to Noland Connect and paste your Vast.ai API key into onboarding.
tutorial.step7.title: Select a server
tutorial.step7.description: After setup, pick a server inside Noland Connect. Choose the one that fits your location, budget, and performance needs.
tutorial.step8.title: Follow the instructions
tutorial.step8.description: Keep following the on-screen instructions during setup. The app will guide you through the remaining pairing steps for Sunshine and Moonlight.
tutorial.step9.title: Sign in to your computer
tutorial.step9.description: Use the credentials configured for your session when the remote computer asks you to sign in.
